_doc: The aim-train range far above the surf course. Lengths in metres, positions relative to 'center' (x right, y up, z toward the spawn; lanes run toward -z). Distances are measured from the firing line. Bot size is movement.json hull_height (72 u), so 'parts' and 'props' positions are fractions of that height in the bot's own frame (x to its left as you face it, z toward the player). A part is a hittable body in a hitgroup; a prop is a mesh riding on a part (when: always, face = any outfit but the burlap sack, wrap / can / plate / hood = that outfit gear). A sphere's 'b', when not zero, stretches its mesh by b.y in height (the hitbox stays the sphere of radius r).
